question: Fundamental Duties of citizens were added to the Constitution of India in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1976.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Fundamental duties were added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment in 1976 of the Constitution for the citizens of India.
